problem: Whether applying the "search existing artifacts + check canonical pointer" procedure actually reduces rework, measurably, compared to not applying it.

decision.decision_summary: Measured E9's real fix cycle against E8's own recorded rework_count baseline.

action.action_summary: Compared E8's rework_count (1, an isolated test had to substitute for a failed full-script run) against E9's (0, the full script succeeded on first real re-run after the fix).

result.note: Describes the improvement PROCESS's own measured effect, not a change to this Goal's real status.

cause.root_cause_summary: The E9 fix (routing through an existing pointer mechanism instead of a hardcoded filename) directly eliminated the failure mode that caused E8's rework.

lesson: A self-improvement action's effect should be measured against the SAME real metric the problem was originally observed in (rework_count), not merely asserted -- this is what turns "we think it helped" into "we measured that it helped".
